Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Tap changer 220kv
 M 111 500
 MR
Introduction

This document outlines the major 
 maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried out every five years as indicated by 
 Y5 in the title block

We recommend a peiodie inspection of the tap changer equipment to certain a high 
reliability in service according to manufacture instruction. Also, we recommend 
that personnel well acquainted with the equipment should carry out the 
inspection. The inspection should be carried out as quickly as possible with the 
most care and tidiness

The first draft initiated and 
tested by eng. Moustafa Abd Allah Eid, approved by eng. Mohamed Lamloum 
general director, accepted by eng. Khairy Eshak Head Sector, certified by eng. 
Ahmed Said Abd El Aziz quality control director, MPIS ME zone Coordinator.
Note

No 
procedures for maintenace in the manual for this type but we can do maintenace 
as follow
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc

items:
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Personnel carrying out the maintenance should be qualified or directly supervised by someone 
 who is
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc

The high voltage CB, low voltage CB of the transformer must be isolated & 
 proper earthing at the two sides is required
Use only fiberglass ladders

Be sure to ground the transformer bushing terminals with on - site grounding 
 equipment and with ancillary grounding cable of a thickness specified by on - 
 site regulation
Caution mark in control room is required

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Mobile oil filtering machine with tank, hoses adapters, and flushing pipe

Mobile. Tin cans to hold bolts nuts and washers crane or davit (suitable for 
 tap changer model)
Empty oil barrels and pails for flushing oil
Oil dielectric tester and oil sample bottles
Megger and multimeter

One set of metric open - end box wrenches, one set of socket wrenches, 
 screwdrivers, venier calipers (metric)
The special tools for the tap changer
Two barrels of new oil
A proper plastic garbage bag to catch oil drips
A plastic ground sheet to cover the work area
A proper plastic or steel tray to wash the diverter and selector with oil in it
Rubber gloves, small brushes, cloth wipes

Spare parts, contacts, contact springs, bolts washers gasket for cover glue 
 and vaseline for gasket o ring
Tap changer support operating key for removal
Special tap changer brushes and handle
Inspection mirror, lubricating grease

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Drive on load tap changer 
to the adjusting position (9).

Drain the oil from the oil 
compartment of the OLTC.

Open the OLTC cover (24 
hex heads screws, M10, wrench size 17, with lock washers) take care of the cover 
gasket (round rubber gasket)

Remove the position 
indicator dial (remove the clip from the shaft end keep washers for reasembly)

Make a note of red - 
marked area not covered by gear plate of the diverter switch unit.

Remove the fixing nuts of 
the diverter switch (5 nuts, M8, wrench size 13, lock washers).

Carefully withdraw the 
diverter switch unit fron the oil compartment. Keep the diverter switch in a 
vertical position.

Put the diverter switch to 
a clean table in workshop.

Clean the diverter switch 
with new oil.

sections.text: Diverter Switch

Check all contacts tightened, 
check by trying to move them by hand

Visually check all 
springs

Check all connecting 
leads, they must be flexible and must be fixed at their fixing points.

Check all sliding 
contacts, if the contact surface is ok clean them.

Push all sliding 
contacts, check if there is enough pressure.

Switch the diverter 
switch in both operating position for doing this check but remember the position you are dismount the diverter switch from the oil 
compartment.

Check the contacts for 
the resistor connection.

Check visually the 
contacts at the resistor and switching contacts.

Measure resistor value.

Check sliding contacts 
and clean them.

Check visually the 
insulating cylinder for discharge traces.

Check of the connection 
to the resistors are faced and tightened.

Check visually the 
resistors for their connection.

sections.text: Oil Compartment

Clean thoroughly 
with new transformer oil

Clean and check 
sliding contacts.

Insert the diverter switch 
unit into the oil compartment.

Watch the guiding 
pin on the bottom plate it must fit into the diverter switch bottom.

Watch the marks 
on the upper metal ring, it must fit to the mark on the rim of the 
tapchanger head.

Screw the holding 
to the upper ring of insulting cylinder and fix it to the oil compartment.

Check with a hand 
crank on the motor driver.

Fill new transformer oil 
into the oil compartment and the conservator
(The break down voltage for oil 
sample 50 kv / 2.5 mm).

Close the OLTC cover and 
make sure that rubber gasket in the cover is in its proper position. Equally 
fasten the 24 screws M 10 (wrench size 17), max. Torque 34 Nm motor drive 
inspection.

Check oupling of motor 
drive and OLTC. it shoud be symmetrically.

Check by hand crank the 
switching of mechanical and elactrical and position.

Check contactors, 
breakers, housing sealing, terminals general condition.

Make test operation by 
hand first then make test operation with electrical drive.

Grease necessary parts 
of motor drive if necessary.

Open bevel gear and 
check it visually.

Grease parts if 
necessary.

Check drive shafts and 
coupling visually and grease them if necessary.

Measure transformer winding 
temperture 
degree C.

Measure the DC 
resistance.

Measure the 
turns ratio on all winding.
Measure (R 60 , R 15).

Set tap changer to 
original 
tap position.
